text: My name is O’mar Diallo, and I am running for Imperial Beach City Council, District 3, because our community deserves strong leadership, practical solutions, and a clear vision for the future.

Imperial Beach is a special place, but we face serious challenges that require action and meaningful community involvement. The Tijuana River sewage crisis continues to threaten our health, environment, and local economy. I will work tirelessly with federal, state, and regional leaders to secure the resources needed to end this crisis once and for all.
I also believe we must support our small businesses, strengthen public safety, invest in our parks and streets, and ensure every tax dollar is spent wisely and responsibly.

As your councilmember, I will listen to residents, lead with transparency, and make City Hall more accountable. Most importantly, I will ensure the community has a meaningful voice in the decisions that shape our future.

Together, we can protect our coastline, strengthen our economy, and preserve the quality of life that makes Imperial Beach unique. I respectfully ask for your vote so we can build a cleaner, safer, and more prosperous Imperial Beach for our families, our children, and future generations.
